title: Permalink & 404 Errors
description: Fix broken permalinks, unexpected 404s, and rewrite rule issues after migrations or server changes.

steps.title: Identify 404 Pattern
steps.instructions: Note whether all pages 404, only posts, only categories, or specific URLs. Check if admin works while front-end pages fail.

steps.title: Flush Permalink Rewrite Rules
steps.instructions: Go to Settings → Permalinks and click Save without changing settings. This regenerates rewrite rules in the database.

steps.title: Verify .htaccess Rewrite Block
steps.instructions: Ensure WordPress rewrite rules exist in .htaccess (Apache) or nginx config points try_files to index.php. Restore default rules if missing or corrupted.

steps.title: Confirm Site URL and Home URL
steps.instructions: Check Settings → General for correct http/https and domain. After migration, update siteurl and home in wp_options or wp-config.php constants if needed.

steps.title: Audit Redirect and SEO Plugins
steps.instructions: Redirection, Rank Math, and Yoast can create conflicting rules. Export redirect list, disable temporarily, and test if 404s resolve.

steps.title: Re-register Custom Post Type Rewrites
steps.instructions: CPT plugins may need a permalink flush after activation. Deactivate/reactivate the CPT plugin or visit Permalinks settings again.

steps.title: Verify Sample URLs
steps.instructions: Test homepage, a recent post, a category archive, and a static page. Confirm sitemap URLs return HTTP 200.
